title: Pop Tart
body:
This mod adds Pop Tarts to Minecraft.

**How do I get a Pop Tart?**

You can craft Pop Tarts using a sweet barry, a piece of wheat, and sugar.

**What Does a Pop Tart do for Me?**

Pop Tarts can be eaten very fast! They give 8 hunger points but no saturation. Amazing for adventuring but bad for fighting.

Goes well with my Mac N Cheese mod!
